name: Heal Critical
description: A critical heal: a tall gold-white pillar of shafts, a burst of feathers and a swelling core of light that washes the frame for a moment.

metadata.analysis: Critical: tallest pillar, all eight shafts, biggest light core, a feather burst and a brief warm wash at the peak that stays gold instead of blowing to white.
metadata.target: invisible humanoid capsule, 1.8 m tall, radius 0.35 m, standing at the origin
